enemy-023-atarax-ripper.method: All 32 prior manually observed thoracic landmarks independently checked on the four unchanged active source boards and prior marked overlays. Horizontal body points retained; root Y is the observed planted-foot/resting-body support edge, exactly three transparent extraction-padding pixels above the former guarded root. Trim transparent padding is required, never fit each frame to its bounds. No aerial pose occurs in these four clips.
enemy-023-atarax-ripper.visualReview: Physical registration only. Alpha and final attack/loop review are documented separately; this review cannot promote the profile.
